recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14137; future UMLS or external code-system identifier work should proceed through THO/TSMG rather than the superseded core note.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary request to document that http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/[SAB] URLs could be used temporarily for UMLS-contained code systems lacking registered identifiers, with a warning that such URLs might not be supported later.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 40536d152413e94ee690d99bdb1cecad8634bc64 added the requested UMLS Note paragraph to source/terminologies-systems.html, including the [SAB] pattern, Multum MediSource Lexicon example, and future-support warning.
additional_context: Later final Vocabulary issues FHIR-27805 and FHIR-25030 requested removal of the same UMLS note because HTA/NLM considered the guidance technically incorrect and improper. Commit 2e0905373f66c2bab9a4ad5e396b3b72f804aec7 removed it, and both later issues already have audit commits on the combined branch. Current source points unlisted code-system URI questions to THO/TSMG instead.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring the original UMLS [SAB] note would contradict later final removal decisions, and the current build-scope terminology page already reflects the modern authority path.
